'''Harvell''' is a member of the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
He is part of a small group that guard [[Matrim Cauthon]] as he stalks the ''[[Gholam]]'' through the back alleys of [[Caemlyn]]. He is injured when a group of assassins attack Mat and is sent back to camp.

== Trivia ==
* Harvell is named for Myles Harvell, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
